candidate_lesson.lesson_text: When the 30-indicator consensus shows conv=100% but green_matches < 4 AND hist_hr is populated, the historical-memory analog is too thin to trust the live conviction — gate entries on green_matches >= 4 to require historical confirmation, not just live agreement.
candidate_lesson.mechanism: Live indicator agreement measures present-tense crowding; green_matches counts how many times this exact multi-indicator fingerprint previously resolved profitably. A 100% live consensus with only 3 historical analogs (AUDUSD case) is a fresh, unvalidated configuration — institutions have not yet been observed reacting to this pattern, so the 68% hist_hr is a small-sample mirage that regresses toward base rate when traded at size.
candidate_lesson.testable_rule: if consensus_conviction >= 1.00 and green_matches < 4: reduce_size_multiplier(0.5) or skip; only full-size when green_matches >= 5 AND hist_hr >= 0.65
candidate_lesson.expected_impact: Filters low-analog 100%-conviction entries; expected win-rate lift of +3-5pp on consensus-driven trades and Sharpe +0.02-0.03 by cutting variance from unvalidated fingerprints.
candidate_lesson.evidence_from_harvest: Live consensus shows GBPUSD conv=100% with green_matches=5 (hist_hr=68%) vs AUDUSD conv=100% with green_matches=3 (hist_hr=68%) — identical hist_hr but AUDUSD rests on far fewer analogs; EURUSD/AUDNZD show conv 50-58% with green_matches=0 and hist_hr=0%, confirming that low green_matches carries no reliable historical edge regardless of live agreement.
